title: Conway Charters
specs: Experience fishing, shelling, sightseeing, eco-tours, manatee and dolphin watching
Captain John has over 30 years of local knowledge and experience
Children ages 2 and up welcome with supervising adults
Children under 6 years must wear flotation device at all times
Notify Captain of any medical conditions immediately when booking
Maximum 4 passengers plus Captain per charter
includes: Boat, rods, reels, tackle, bait, ice, coolers
Cleaning and bagging of all legal sized fish and game in season
Free fishing licenses for all passengers
gap: Exact age minimum for children not stated beyond 2 years old
blurb: Guests join Captain John Conway on a private boat for fishing, shelling, sightseeing, and eco-tours around Southwest Florida. Charters include expert guidance, fishing gear, bait, and safety equipment. The boat accommodates up to 4 passengers plus the Captain.
extraNote: Valid credit card required to secure charter · Meet at boat 5 minutes prior to scheduled time; late arrival may shorten charter or incur no-show fee · Captain may cancel charters due to bad weather or boat problems · Cancel minimum 48 hours in advance or $100 non-refundable charge plus 4% credit card fee applies · No-shows charged full charter amount plus 4% credit card fee · Dockside pickup at locations throughout Lee County including Pine Island, Sanibel, Cape Coral, Fort Myers, and Fort Myers Beach; pickup location scheduled with Captain upon booking.
